score: 133.1 s (DuckDB's optimizer 274.5 s with 3 timeouts; true sizes 134.3 s)
metric: Total DuckDB runtime of the 146 queries with join trees and hash sides chosen by KumoSQL's DPccp optimizer from its own estimates. Postgres 16 estimates through the same optimizer: 170.9 s with 1 timeout. Plan cost (C_out under true sizes) is 1.009x optimal on average and 1.59x at worst (Postgres estimates 1.11x, 6.4x).
caveats: Timeouts count as 60 s; 4 threads, one container, best of two runs. Tuned on test, as for the cardinality row. Letting DuckDB choose hash sides gives 98.8 s here but doubles JOB's time, so one setting is used for both.
correctness: Every executed plan returned the published COUNT(*).
held_out: none (JOB families 17-33 are the held-out workload)
